stories.title: 'We did not select the 49ers at all': The true story behind 49ers-Rams debuting in Melbourne
stories.summary: The NFL's latest and farthest international venture is to Melbourne, Australia. How did the 49ers and Rams fit into those plans?

stories.title: 49ers' Melbourne visit a dream come true for team's Australian fans
stories.summary: The 49ers are the most popular NFL team in Australia, with many fans watching since the Joe Montana-Jerry Rice days.

stories.title: Tua suffers oblique injury in practice; Rush takes Falcons' QB1 reps
stories.summary: Falcons quarterback Tua Tagovailoa sustained an oblique injury in practice Thursday and was listed as a limited participant.

stories.title: Seahawks' Darnold gets 'really good news' about hip, expected to miss Week 2
stories.summary: Sam Darnold has received "really good news" regarding his hip injury, coach Mike Macdonald said, but the Seahawks QB is expected to miss next week's game, sources said.

stories.title: Giants' Nabers says it will be his call if he plays against Cowboys
stories.summary: Wide receiver Malik Nabers said Thursday that the Giants are leaving the decision on whether he plays Sunday night against the Cowboys up to him.
